item_name: Rothco R.E.D. (Remember Everyone Deployed) Low Profile Cap
item_short_desc: Show your support for deployed service personnel with Rothco’s R.E.D. (Remember Everyone Deployed) Low Profile Cap. This patriotic cap features an embroidered American flag on the front panel, accompanied by the meaningful “Remember Everyone Deployed” text. Additional “R.E.D.” lettering is embroidered on the back for a complete design. Made from durable and soft brushed cotton twill, this baseball hat ensures superior comfort and longevity.
